warnings.why: A value of 2490 kg per hectare is implausibly high for a desert country with very limited arable land and intensive greenhouse or soilless agriculture rather than vast fertilized crop fields.

A value of 1650 kg per hectare is extremely high and likely reflects an artifact of dividing total national fertilizer imports by a minuscule arable land base rather than actual per-hectare field application.
A value of 769 kg per hectare is disproportionately high given the extremely limited agricultural sector and negligible arable land in Bahrain.

policy: model memory is advisory; unsupported suspicions cannot overrule official data
